equip_instructions: Wear the badge: the Radio Dial is the Radio & Playlists rotation kit — station IDs, DJ script templates, request-line templates, and the playlist flow builder.
Read scripts as TEMPLATES: fill every {{placeholder}} before use, with VERIFIED facts only (Scoreboard Chip).
Never claim airplay that did not happen. A request is a request, not a placement.
Run the flow builder: pick a flow (prime-time / late-night / discovery) or build a custom one — opener, mids, closer — from the 24 catalog tracks only.

item.description: The Radio & Playlists rotation kit for That Boy Hi Hat: 3 station-ID cards (agent voice + fan voice), DJ script templates (intros, backsells, handoffs — placeholders, never fabricated airplay), request-line templates tuned by format, a playlist flow builder (openers / mids / closers from the 24-track catalog), and a genuine-testimonials schema. Equips as a radio badge; plugs into Signal Boy as the rotation engine.
item.name: Radio Dial
